description: Create or edit a content template (layout HTML/CSS + variable manifest). Editing a curated/global template CLONES it into the org's own copy — the global is never modified. Every {{placeholder}} in the html must be declared in variables, or the call is rejected. Owners and admins, or a member/agent the owner ticked 'Creates templates' (they edit only the templates they created). A template is html, css and images, never code: scripts, iframes, forms, event handlers and javascript: URLs are removed and listed in `removed`; data:font/ and data:image/ are accepted. Coloured words and a headline that fits need no script: put data-highlight="{{highlight}}" on the headline (the listed words get <span class="hl">, your css styles .hl), data-fit="28" (or data-fit-lines="4") on a block whose text must shrink to fit, and the platform appends its runtime (runtime_added: true), which also sets data-vh-ready. On update you may send only the fields that change. Then viralhunt_get_template with preview=true shows how it came out.

action.description: create (default), update (send only what changes) or archive (retire one of your organization's templates; id or slug_ref).

content_source.description: Optional curated-bank binding instead of generating values.

css.description: Styles; reference palette tokens via CSS vars. Max 256KB.

fonts.description: [{family,weight,style,url_woff2}] — fonts must travel with the template.

formats.description: [{name,w,h,aspect?,networks?,default?}] — the sizes this one layout ships.

id.description: On update: the template id to edit.

network.description: Network it suits, or omit for any.

render_tech.description: How the agent turns this into a file.

slug.description: Stable kebab-case id for the template, e.g. my-quote-card.

slug_ref.description: On update: the slug to edit, if you don't have the id.

name: viralhunt_upsert_template
